title: Vertical and reentrant ferromagnetic boundaries below the Nishimori point
summary: We prove that below the multicritical (Nishimori) point the ferromagnetic boundary of a biased Ising spin glass, argued by Nishimori (1986) to be exactly vertical, can be vertical and can also be reentrant, so that cooling at fixed disorder destroys order. It is vertical in the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) model with a Curie-Weiss bias $J_0$, and reentrant near the triple point of fully connected $p$-spin glasses and, at one disorder strength, on a decorated planar $\mathbb{Z}^2$-periodic lattice.
